title: Puss in Boots
writer: Charles Perrault, Hisashi Inoue, Morihisa Yamamoto
actors: Susumu Ishikawa, Toshiko Fujita, Rumi Sakakibara
plot: While being on the run for saving a mouse, the famous Puss in Boots, Pero, helps a young peasant boy win the heart of a lovely princess, while trying to rescue her from an evil wizard.
